new_today_news.headline: Darling Ingredients (NYSE:DAR) Issues Earnings Results
new_today_news.summary: Diamond Green Diesel delivered $389 million of EBITDA on approximately 350 million gallons sold in Q2 2026, supported by attractive renewable-fuel margins and a $51 million IEEPA tariff recovery. Management expects continued favorable margins and roughly 335 million gallons of production in Q3 2026.

new_today_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Q2 2026 Earnings Call Highlights - Strong Renewable Fuel Performance
new_today_news.summary: Diamond Green Diesel, Darling's renewable fuel joint venture, delivered $389 million EBITDA in Q2 2026 on approximately 350 million gallons sold, supported by attractive margins and a $51 million IEEPA tariff recovery. DGD produced 1.3 million metric tons of renewable fuel during the quarter, maintaining its position as the largest global producer.

new_today_news.headline: GFL Environmental Reports Q2 2026 Results with Revenue Up 16.3%, Raises Full-Year Guidance
new_today_news.summary: GFL Environmental reported Q2 2026 revenue of $1.95 billion, up 16.3% year-over-year, and raised its full-year 2026 guidance for the second time in 2026. The company also disclosed that multiple private equity firms have expressed interest in a take-private transaction.
